name: release
description: Workflow for taking finished work to production: review the change, prove it with the existing suite, add the observability it needs, then ship it with a rollback path.

stages.purpose: Review exactly what is about to go out, including everything merged since the last release.
Run and extend the suite against the release candidate so 'green' means something.
Add the logging, metrics, and alerting needed to see this release fail before users do.
Execute the launch checklist: staged rollout, monitoring, and a rehearsed rollback.

rules: Complete each stage before treating it as complete.
No release goes out with an unverified claim in its notes.
If the rollback path has not been rehearsed, the release is blocked, not 'mostly ready'.
Do not claim verification that did not happen.
completion: The release is complete when the rollout finished, the monitoring in place confirms healthy behaviour, and the rollback path is documented and rehearsed.
